title: Build the empty-state project page first: full fixed 6-stage shape (dashed) plus Documents empty state with warmth and a 'Link a document' primary action
source_finding: empty state is every project's first impression and the adoption argument made visible

title: Choose and wire a distinctive display typeface (not system-ui/Segoe UI) for project name and section headers
source_finding: Segoe UI is the M365/SharePoint system font; using it makes Compass look like another Microsoft page

title: Auto-derive the running-late slip flag from date math (target passed AND milestone not done), not PM-entered
source_finding: the one place v1 can show truth instead of typed-in status; builds trust cheaply

title: Specify loading (skeleton of the 6 known nodes) and error (inline couldnt-load retry) states
source_finding: interaction states unspecified; cheap because the project shape is fixed

title: Define the lifecycle-object schema with enums enforced in schema AND server (lifecycle, role, step status), required customer FK, and row_version for optimistic locking. No create-milestone-type or add-field endpoint exists.
source_finding: D1/D6. BLOCKED: must wait for The Assignment to pass and the Sign-off step question to settle, because changing the shape after the schema is frozen is a migration

title: Entra ID OIDC SSO. v1 access model: read for any authenticated employee, edit for any authenticated employee.
source_finding: D2. Per-role views are phase 2 where the real authorization work lives; do not build phase-2 authz now

title: Server-rendered milestone-centric project page: header (customer chip, lifecycle three-way, updated-by/on stamp), milestone stream with 4-step trackers and highlighted current milestone, Responsible panel (5 roles), Project docs.
source_finding: Performance [P3]: eager-load Project to Customer to roles to milestones to steps to doclinks with joins; no per-milestone N+1

title: Build the empty-state first: lifecycle set to NPD, customer = Select customer (required pick), roles list with PM set and the other four showing Assign, milestones area stating the rule with one action Create the first milestone.
source_finding: The empty state is the adoption argument made visible. Supersedes design-review T1 (its 6-stage wording is stale; model is now the 4-step milestone)

title: Open editing with mandatory updated_by/updated_at on every write, optimistic locking via row_version, and archive/close instead of hard-delete.
source_finding: D2/D2a/D2b/D6. Under open editing the stamp is the only accountability, so it is non-skippable

title: Auto-derive the running-late flag from date math (current step target date passed AND status not done). Never stored, never entered.
source_finding: The one un-fakeable trust signal in v1. Supersedes design-review T3

title: DocLink: store and render raw SharePoint URLs only. No Graph API, no permission-trimming, no title fetch.
source_finding: SharePoint linked not integrated; its own access-denied handles missing access

title: Full v1 test suite (target 10/10 from first commit): slip rule, rigidity enforcement, edit authz+stamp, optimistic lock, customer FK, enum validation, doclink, and 3 E2E (create-project, edit-step to stamp to slip, empty-state).
source_finding: Greenfield, coverage 0/10. Slip rule and rigidity enforcement are the two top-priority tests

title: Loading (skeleton of the known milestone/step nodes) and error (inline could-not-load plus retry) states.
source_finding: Supersedes design-review T4; cheap because the page shape is fixed

title: Wire a distinctive display typeface (not system-ui/Segoe UI) for project name and section headers; confirm font licensing.
source_finding: Supersedes design-review T2. Adoption-lever claim is a hypothesis not evidence, and licensing is a real dependency, so do not over-invest pre-Assignment
